name: The Tastes Of Lives
original_name: เลือดใหม่หัวใจนักปรุง
overview: The story of Parichart, owner of a Thai cooking school, whose strong determination to pass down traditional recipes brings together people from different backgrounds with their own stories to meet at this school, including her only daughter Parichat and her grandson Pokpong, who shares his grandmother’s passion for cooking.
